description:
Create a new Layout Based Visit Form (LBF) in LibreHealth EHR named 'Neurology Intake'. 

1. Log in as admin (admin/password).
2. Navigate to Administration > Forms > Layouts (or Layout Based).
3. Create a new form with ID 'LBF_Neuro' and Title 'Neurology Intake'.
4. Add a new Group titled 'Reflexes'.
5. Inside this group, add two Text fields: 'Patellar Reflex' and 'Achilles Reflex'.
6. Ensure the form and fields are active/enabled and saved.
